title: 5. Gram Sabha – Foundation of Panchayati Raj

blocks.content: The Gram Sabha is a body consisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village comprised within the area of Panchayat at the village level.

rows: All registered voters in the village

items: Gram Sabha is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution like the Gram Panchayat.
Article 243A specifically defines the constitutional status and powers of the Gram Sabha.
Membership is automatic for all registered voters in the village, making it a direct democratic institution.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Gram Sabha forms the foundational pillar of the Panchayati Raj System in India.
It comprises all persons registered in the electoral rolls of a village within the Panchayat area.
Article 243A empowers the Gram Sabha to exercise powers and perform functions assigned by the state legislature.
It acts as a primary tool for direct democracy, social audits, and grassroot decision-making.
